description: [Full — FREE with a WebAbility account. Not runnable in Lite. Connect hosted MCP at https://mcp.webability.io/mcp (dashboard or Smithery: webability/accessibility), authenticate, then call `visual_audit`.] Pixel-level accessibility audit using Claude vision. Catches issues that DOM scanners miss: icon contrast (1.4.11), focus visibility (2.4.7), "looks like a button but isn't" (4.1.2), text rendered as images (1.4.5), visual hierarchy mismatches. Takes a URL, opens it in a headless browser, screenshots, and runs vision-based detection. Complements scan_page — run both for full coverage. Sign in with a free WebAbility account for vision and full audits (sign in by connecting https://mcp.webability.io/mcp/auth, or run `webability login`). Fair-use rate limits apply.
